segments.title: AI can send you to fake stores
segments.say: Shopping with AI? It can send you to a fake store.

segments.title: 151 brands, three chatbots
segments.say: A brand-protection firm, Podqi, asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity about one hundred fifty-one brands.

segments.title: About 1 in 11 answers
segments.say: About one in eleven answers pointed to a risky site: fake, or a dead domain.

segments.title: Fakes or dead domains
segments.say: Think copycat stores, counterfeits, and dead domains a scammer could buy.

segments.title: Before Black Friday, do this
bullets: Check the spelling of the URL
Pay only on the real site
segments.say: Before Black Friday, type the brand's website yourself, check the spelling, and only pay there.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to the friend who asks AI where to shop, and follow Nexora.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
